description.value: Pizza Art is a halal pizza restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby, part of a two-location operation serving Burnaby and Surrey. The menu spans meat, chicken, veggie, seafood, and classic pizza categories, alongside lahmacun, köfte, and salads. Dough is hand-stretched daily by in-house chefs, and the kitchen accommodates vegan and gluten-free diets.
